title: Anti-Lipschitz maps on subsets of ℝⁿ satisfy Lⁿ(S) ≤ Kⁿ·Hⁿ(f(S))
statement: Let n, p ∈ ℕ and write ℝᵈ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) with the Euclidean norm |·|. Let f : ℝⁿ → ℝᵖ be any map, S ⊆ ℝⁿ an arbitrary set (not assumed measurable), and K ∈ ℝ≥0 such that |x − y| ≤ K·|f(x) − f(y)| for all x, y ∈ S. Then Lⁿ(S) ≤ Kⁿ·Hⁿ(f(S)) in [0, ∞]. Here Lⁿ = volume is Lebesgue outer measure on ℝⁿ, and Hⁿ = μHE[n] is the Euclidean-normalised n-dimensional Hausdorff outer measure on ℝᵖ.
lean_statement: ∀ (n p : ℕ) (f : Rn n → Rn p) (S : Set (Rn n)) (K : ℝ≥0), (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, ‖x - y‖ ≤ K * ‖f x - f y‖) → volume S ≤ (K : ℝ≥0∞) ^ n * μHE[n] (f '' S)
